disputable.why: The evidence ('Takedowns ... grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses') says nothing about the stacks being permanent or uncapped; her old dragon stacks were effectively capped. Verify the reworked Scalemail has no maximum before keeping her.

fun.why: Almost everyone gets Nasus or Veigar, a good share find Senna, Smolder, Cho'Gath or Thresh, and very few list all 14 (Swain, Bard, Bel'Veth, Kindred, Sion are satisfying finds).

champion:Nasus.why: Siphoning Strike stacks are the definition of infinite scaling.

champion:Veigar.why: Phenomenal Evil Power is the other textbook answer.

champion:Senna.why: Mist souls are well known to scale forever.

champion:Smolder.why: Recent, stack-centred champion; Q stacks are his whole identity.

champion:AurelionSol.why: Stardust stacks are his rework identity but less top-of-mind.

champion:Chogath.why: Feast stacks making him huge is iconic.

champion:Swain.why: Ravenous Flock's permanent max Health is known to Swain players but rarely the first thought.

champion:Thresh.why: Soul collection is famous among support players.

champion:Kindred.why: Marks scale range and damage forever; jungle players know it.

champion:Sion.why: W max Health per kill is known, but players think of Sion's passive/ult first.

champion:Belveth.why: R's stacking true damage is easy to forget; most remember her attack speed.

champion:Shyvana.why: Reworked Scalemail stacks are barely known.

champion:Locke.why: New champion; few know his R threshold grows.

champion:Bard.why: Chimes scaling Meeps forever is known to support players, rarely first.

gemCandidates.why: 'Oh of course!': his ravens' Soul Fragments permanently raise his max Health, and late-game Swain is huge. About 0.15, outside the likeliest half now the Rule no longer names him.
His W gives max Health on every kill, and tank-Sion players stack thousands of HP. About 0.2.
Her R passive true damage 'stacking infinitely' is in the tooltip but rarely remembered; about 0.1.
